identity_font_finding.conclusion: Round-3 Arial-like face was a capture-fixture artifact, not a product defect
identity_font_finding.cause: Go serves ./css and ./fonts relative to the working directory (internal/api/server.go); the image WORKDIR / provides /css and /fonts (Dockerfile); the 2026-10-26 fleet capture driver ran the server in a bare scratch dir, so /css/styles.css and /fonts/* returned 404
identity_font_finding.fix: archived driver docs/ui-visual-refinement-2026-10-26/capture.mjs symlinks repo css/ and fonts/ into the scratch dir; capture-core records loaded_fonts per capture
identity_font_finding.evidence: every capture in this batch, BEFORE included, loaded Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono; the type change vs round-3 images is fixture drift and is not claimed as product improvement
identity_font_finding.product_defect_found: with fonts loaded, the pre-bundle /css/styles.css .brand rule made the app wordmark mono; fixed in web/src/index.css
